slug: 2026-03-03 Nigeria's Disharmonised Digital System Leaving Low-Income Farmers Behind

systems.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth (BRIDGE)
systems.platform: 90,000 km of fibre, taking the national backbone from 35,000 km to 125,000 km
systems.owner: Government of Nigeria; US$500m World Bank financing approved October 2025
systems.tiers: when completed, to 'connect every local government', thousands of schools and clinics and agricultural research stations; no local government office said to be on it

systems.owner: federal government, with the Agric Infrastructure Fund
systems.tiers: rural hubs to be equipped with basic internet; a work in progress

note: Field report on farmers' identity verification; the fibre project is described as a future network that will reach every local government, with no local government office stated as connected.
